vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is an owner privilege abuse in a MasterChef-style contract. The owner can set a migrator contract that can call transferFrom() to transfer lpTokens from the MasterChef to any address. By setting a malicious migrator and calling migrate(), the attacker can drain all lpToken balances from the contract.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the owner of the MasterChef contract. 2. Deploy a malicious migrator contract that implements a migrate() function which transfers lpTokens to the attacker. 3. Call setMigrator() on MasterChef to set our malicious migrator. 4. Call migrate() on MasterChef with a pool ID that has lpToken balance to drain the tokens.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 2. Deploy MaliciousMigrator contract. 3. Call setMigrator() on MasterChef with our migrator address. 4. Find a pool with lpToken balance (we'll need to check storage or assume pool 0). 5. Call migrate() on MasterChef with the pool ID. 6. Verify the attacker's balance of lpTokens increased.
